title: L5R.Engine Card Document
description: Cards are data, not code: each document references a fixed catalog of generic effects/game actions/costs registered in the C# engine, the same pattern ringteki itself uses (see card-schema.md for the field-by-field mapping to docs/implementing-cards.md). Effect/game-action/cost 'name' fields are plain strings here, deliberately NOT enumerated against the ~100/~80/~25-entry catalogs - the engine's registries are the single source of truth for what's valid, checked at card-load time, so this schema and the registries can't silently drift apart. Anything that doesn't fit this generic vocabulary uses scriptOverride.

id.description: Slug matching the emeralddb card id (emeralddb.org/api/cards). Links this file to the card's printed cost/traits/text, which live in emeralddb data rather than being duplicated here.

faction.description: Clan slug; null/omitted for neutral cards.

printedCost.description: Printed fate cost (character/attachment/event). emeralddb field: cost.

text.description: Printed rules text. Reference/UI only - the engine never parses this; abilities below are what actually run.

triggeredAbilities.description: Reactions and interrupts (forced or optional), and 'would' interrupts. implementing-cards.md 'Triggered abilities'.

persistentEffect.description: implementing-cards.md 'Persistent effects'. Corresponds to this.persistentEffect({...}) in ringteki. Always Durations.Persistent - effects that expire (untilEndOfConflict/Phase/Round) are declared instead as a cardLastingEffect/playerLastingEffect/ringLastingEffect gameAction on an action/reaction, not here.

match.description: implementing-cards.md 'Matching conditions vs matching specific cards'. 'self' is shorthand for matching only this card (equivalent to passing `this` in ringteki). Omit entirely for player-scoped effects (effects.js 'Player effects') - those must not have a match.

condition.description: implementing-cards.md 'Conditional effects'. Defaults to always-true when omitted.

targetController.description: implementing-cards.md 'Targeting opponent or all matching cards' / 'Player modifying effects'. 'current' is the player-effect default per ringteki effects.js.

targetLocation.description: implementing-cards.md 'Applying effects to cards which aren't in play'. E.g. 'hand', 'province'.

sourceLocation.description: ringteki Effect.js 'location' property: where the card providing this effect must itself be for the effect to be active - distinct from targetLocation, which is about the cards the effect applies to. 'any' means the effect stays active even from hand/discard (e.g. seppun-guardsman).

effect.description: implementing-cards.md 'Applying multiple effects at once' allows an array.

match.description: Extra condition on the attached card, beyond 'is the card this is attached to'.

effectEntry.description: One entry from ringteki's effects.js catalog (~100 names spanning card/ring/player/conflict effects), resolved against the engine's EffectRegistry at card-load time.

value.description: effects.js distinguishes static (plain literal), dynamic (recomputed each pass) and flexible (either) effects - see implementing-cards.md 'Dynamic skill'. Omit for effects that take no value (e.g. doesNotBow).

gameActionEntry.description: One entry from ringteki's GameActions.ts catalog (~80 names), resolved against the engine's GameActionRegistry at card-load time. `params` is intentionally free-form: each game action's own parameter shape (e.g. cardLastingEffect's nested duration+effect) is validated by its C# implementation, not by this schema - typing all ~80 shapes here would duplicate that validation and drift from it over time.

target.description: Overrides the default target (source card for card actions, opponent for player actions, contested ring for ring actions). implementing-cards.md 'Game Actions'.

params.description: Action-specific parameters, e.g. { "amount": 1 } for gainFate, or { "duration": "untilEndOfConflict", "effect": [...] } for cardLastingEffect.

costEntry.description: One entry from ringteki's costs.js catalog (~25 names: bowSelf, sacrificeSelf, dishonor, payFate, payHonor, discardCard, ...), resolved against the engine's CostRegistry at card-load time. `params` is free-form for the same reason as gameActionEntry.params.

target.description: implementing-cards.md 'Choosing / targeting cards', 'Multiple targets', 'Targeting rings', 'Select options'.

mode.description: ringteki Constants.ts TargetModes (subset commonly hand-authored on cards; ability/token/exactlyVariable/upToVariable are engine-internal).

gameAction.description: Restricts legal targets to those this game action (or any, if an array) could legally affect.

choices.description: mode: 'select' only. Key is the label shown to the player; value is either a predicate or a game action used to determine legality.

player.description: Which player makes this choice - almost always self, but e.g. an opponent chooses which card to discard on some cards.

dependsOn.description: Name of another key in this ability's `targets` map that must be resolved first; this target (commonly mode: 'select', with choices referencing the dependency via contextPath e.g. 'targets.character') only resolves afterwards.

effect.description: implementing-cards.md 'Effect messages'. Required when gameAction has more than one entry.

max.description: Limit shared across all copies of this card by title, vs. limit which is per physical card.

triggeredAbility.description: implementing-cards.md 'Triggered abilities'. ringteki triggeredability.js; 'trigger' selects which of this.reaction/forcedReaction/interrupt/forcedInterrupt/wouldInterrupt ringteki would use.

when.description: Key is an EventNames.* value (ringteki Constants.ts), value is a predicate evaluated against the event and context.

aggregateWhen.description: Rare: triggers once for a batch of simultaneous events rather than per-event. Most cards needing this use scriptOverride instead.

handler.description: implementing-cards.md ''Would' interrupts': the only built-in non-gameAction handler is context.cancel(), used by wouldInterrupt abilities that cancel the triggering event. Anything else needing a bespoke handler function uses scriptOverride.

predicate.description: Closed, declarative predicate vocabulary used for match/condition/cardCondition/ringCondition/when. Deliberately not Turing-complete - it's an interpreter over a fixed instruction set the C# engine evaluates directly, not an embedded scripting language. Anything a card needs that this vocabulary can't express is exactly what scriptOverride is for.

type.description: Omit to match either conflict type.

oneOf.description: Existential check over a set of cards, e.g. 'does the player control any participating character with trait X' - condition/cardCondition otherwise evaluate a single implicit subject, not a collection.

valueRef.description: A literal, a dotted path into the current ability context (mirrors ringteki's `context => ({...})` property factories for the handful of paths cards actually use), or a named engine-provided dynamic value. Same closed-vocabulary philosophy as predicate.

dynamic.description: Name of an engine-registered dynamic value function, e.g. countHoldingsInPlay.

for.description: Which player the named counter is computed for. Added porting kaiu-shuichi, whose condition needs the same counter evaluated once per player (e.g. compareValues on {dynamic, for: self} and {dynamic, for: opponent} combined with predicate 'or') - dynamic previously assumed a single implicit subject.

role.description: Which conflict role the named counter is computed for, e.g. {dynamic: conflictParticipantCount, role: attacker} for ringteki's currentConflict.getNumberOfParticipantsFor('attacker'). Added porting mirumoto-prodigy/admit-defeat, whose conditions key off participant count by conflict role rather than by player - a different axis from 'for'.

oneOf.description: Resolves to an entire set of cards rather than a single value - for gameAction targets that bulk-apply to a whole scope (e.g. grasp-of-earth's 'every card the opponent controls') rather than a single value or a player-chosen target. Not valid outside a gameActionEntry.target position.

A structured parameter bag for effects whose value is inherently an options object rather than a scalar - e.g. cardCannot/playerCannot/immunity's restriction properties (ringteki Effects/restriction.js), such as { "cannot": "play", "restricts": "events" }.

scriptOverride.description: Escape valve for cards whose logic doesn't fit the generic vocabulary above. Can supplement a card's declarative abilities (override just the one clause that doesn't fit) or replace them entirely - implementer's call, but 'reason' must say which and why.

handler.description: Fully-qualified C# type name implementing ICardScript, resolved via reflection at card-load time.
